reasons.changed_since_preview: The event was changed or removed after the preview.

reasons.private_kept: Marked private in the file, so a published event is left untouched.
reasons.invalid_event: The event's details were not accepted.
reasons.floating_time: No time zone given: read in the calendar's zone.
reasons.default_duration: No end given: one hour assumed.
reasons.shifted_local_time: The time does not exist that day (clock change): moved forward.
reasons.start_adjusted: The first date was not part of the repeat: moved to the first one that is.
reasons.exdate_ignored: Some skipped dates are not part of the repeat and were ignored.
reasons.override_fields_dropped: Changed dates keep the series' title and place; only their times are imported.
reasons.override_dropped: Some changed dates could not be used and were left out.
reasons.category_dropped: The category is not one of this site's: left out.
reasons.kept_draft_private: Marked private in the file: kept as a draft.
reasons.uid_generated: No identifier in the file: one was made from the date and title.
reasons.description_truncated: The description was cut to its maximum length.
reasons.kept_utc: A repeating event in UTC: its times stay in UTC, so they do not move with the clock change.
reasons.invalid_local_time: This time does not exist in the timezone: the clocks skip it.
reasons.too_many_properties: This event has too many properties and was not imported.
reasons.too_many_parameters: A property of this event has too many parameters; it was not imported.
reasons.event_too_large: This event is too large and was not imported.
reasons.too_many_attendees: This event has too many attendees and was not imported.
reasons.title_truncated: The title was cut to its maximum length.
reasons.place_truncated: The place was cut to its maximum length.
